lines.x: If there's nothing to do, I'll... be here.
Since when was I in the Activity Room...? Since... before you came in...
Vegetables... could grow well here.
You want me to play the guitar? Okay.
I got this fragrance from Perfumer-san. She says Gloria uses it too.
Heheh... It's nice to... meet expectations.
So you... also waver, and can't make up your mind... I... do that a lot...
Saki once said... we're all 'badgers in the same hole'.
Here, nobody recognizes... Minami-chan and Ta-kun...
Did I wake you up? Sorry.
Mutsumi Wakaba... Nice to meet you.
I can tell... this isn't just for show. These people, they really died.
I need... more practice...
You're... praising me...
Okay.
I think... Saki should be better...
Let's get started.
Enemies... they're coming.
I'm... ready.
I'm prepared.
I've got no... choice...
I can't... fail.
I'll try...
These enemies aren't all that scary.
Just don't... think at all...
Just do it like I practiced.
Thank goodness.
I didn't... fail this time.
Thank you for... covering for me...
I... messed things up again...
I'll be... right here.
What is it?
I'm practicing.
Arknights.
I was on stage just now... No, not Ave Mujica. The Rhodes Island play. I was a tree.
Doctor. I didn't have any nightmares, last night... What about you?
Happy... birthday. This is… your present.
It's so lively outside. Are you sure you're not going...? You're staying in? Okay.
